neighbours.label: the stems optim- / conserv- in stance words (optimistic, optimist, conservatively)
fire: Despite the losses, the coach remained optimistic about the season.
Analysts are cautiously optimistic that prices will fall.
My grandfather was an incurable optimist about everything.
The report estimated the costs conservatively at two million.
She spoke optimistically about the peace talks.
Even the most optimistic forecasts predict a slow recovery.
Investors were less optimistic after the weak earnings report.
We budgeted conservatively, assuming only half the tickets would sell.
quiet: Despite the losses, the coach remained calm about the season.
Analysts are fairly confident that prices will fall.
My grandfather was an incurable joker about everything.
The report estimated the costs roughly at two million.
She spoke cheerfully about the peace talks.
Even the most detailed forecasts predict a slow recovery.
Investors were less enthusiastic after the weak earnings report.
We budgeted carefully, assuming only half the tickets would sell.

notes: Card: ' optim' x7, ' conserv', 'cons', 'Opt' in top 32; output promotes conservative/pessim/optim/cautious.
